name: agentshare-price-mcp
display_name: AgentShare — curated MCP registry + own MCP
description: Curated MCP registry. Live serverInfo name agentshare-registry, 15 tools at https://agentshare.dev/mcp. Default path: search_listing, check_health, evidence_pack, then connect to mcp_url yourself. Own tools on dual-auth rails (API key or x402): request_capability, commerce, secondary Solana/Meteora DeFi demos. Polymarket is not on the public catalog.

tools.name: search_listing
tools.description: Search verified MCP listings by keyword. At most 10. Active Featured listings sort first and are marked sponsored. Does not ping.

tools.name: check_health
tools.description: Read one listing's stored health_status, last_checked_at, and schema_status. The probe is about a day old. Does not ping.

tools.name: evidence_pack
tools.description: Verified Evidence Pack for one listing: observed, inferred, or unknown, with limitations. Not a Trust Score. Does not ping.

tools.name: solana_dex_brief
tools.description: Solana DEX ecosystem brief: Raydium, Orca, Meteora protocol-level volume and verdict (DefiLlama)

tools.name: meteora_brief
tools.description: Meteora DLMM pool brief: ranked pools, momentum_score, verdict SAFE/CAUTION/AVOID. Dynamic x402 $0.01–$0.30 — check PAYMENT-REQUIRED for live quote.

tools.name: meteora_pool_detail
tools.description: Meteora DLMM pool detail: bin depth, liquidity curve proxy, current price

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search product listings; scope and sources match GET /coverage on agentshare.dev

tools.name: best_offer
tools.description: Find the single lowest in-stock price for a product intent

tools.name: best_offer_under_budget
tools.description: Find best offer within a price ceiling

tools.name: product_detail
tools.description: Full product and per-source prices by numeric id from search

tools.name: commerce_quote
tools.description: ACP agent-buyer quote envelope (agentshare.price.v1) for procurement workflows

tools.name: request_capability
tools.description: Custom Request Tool: structured capability gap for human admin review (auth + stake; no codegen)

tools.name: service_meta
tools.description: Get API capabilities, limits, and coverage metadata

api_key.title: AgentShare API Key
api_key.description: Start building at https://agentshare.dev/signup (free-tier dual-auth) or settle x402 per request
